strings.name: Donald Trump
strings.summary: Trump moved from his family’s New York property business into branding and television before winning the presidency as the Republican candidate. He began two non-consecutive presidential terms in 2017 and 2025. His political influence has coexisted with deeply divided public opinion. Two impeachments by the House of Representatives, disputes over the 2020 election and criminal proceedings are important parts of his biography.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones through January 2025. Legal entries describe decisions at the time and are not live updates on subsequent appeals or case status.
strings.facts.fact-01.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-01.value: Queens, New York City, United States
strings.facts.fact-02.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-02.value: Bachelor’s degree in economics, Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania (1968)
strings.facts.fact-03.label: Main roles
strings.facts.fact-03.value: Republican politician; businessman and television host
strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Two non-consecutive presidential terms
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Sworn in in 2017 and 2025 as the 45th and 47th presidents of the United States.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Business and mass media
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Expanded the family property business into hotels and brand licensing, and reached a national television audience through The Apprentice.
strings.highlights.highlight-03.title: A major controversial figure in US politics
strings.highlights.highlight-03.text: Impeached twice by the House and acquitted twice by the Senate; political and legal controversies have profoundly shaped his public image.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Sworn in as president for a second time
strings.timeline.event-01.text: After winning the 2024 election, began his second, non-consecutive term as the 47th US president.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Convicted in New York criminal trial
strings.timeline.event-02.text: A jury found him guilty on 34 felony counts of falsifying business records. In January 2025, he received an unconditional discharge, with no imprisonment or fine.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Impeached by the House a second time
strings.timeline.event-03.text: After the attack on the Capitol, the House impeached him for incitement of insurrection; the Senate acquitted him that February.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: First impeachment by the House
strings.timeline.event-04.text: The House brought charges of abuse of power and obstruction of Congress; the Senate acquitted him in February 2020.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Sworn in as president for the first time
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Following his 2016 election victory, became the 45th US president, serving his first term until 2021.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Announces presidential campaign
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Launched his campaign as a Republican, bringing fame accumulated in business and television into electoral politics.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Begins hosting The Apprentice
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Became the central figure in NBC’s business-competition reality show, broadening his mass-media influence.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Takes over the family business
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Took charge of the family property business and later expanded into Manhattan real estate, hotels and brand licensing.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Completes university education
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Earned a bachelor’s degree in economics from the University of Pennsylvania and then joined his father’s property business full-time.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in New York City
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Born and raised in a property developer’s family in Queens; attended the New York Military Academy in his youth.
